# The Decentralized Compute Company

Official domain: https://decentralizedcompute.company/

TDCC is building a verified, serverless AI execution network powered by user-owned GPUs.

## Core product
- A conventional developer API for supported AI workloads.
- Model-aware routing across heterogeneous GPU hosts and certified micro-clusters.
- Secure, approved execution environments.
- Workload-specific verification and reputation.
- Settlement and payouts for accepted work.

## Initial workloads
- Batch inference
- Image generation
- Audio transcription
- Embeddings
- Evaluations
- Synthetic data
- Agent workloads
- LoRA / QLoRA fine-tuning
- Open-model hosting
- Adapter serving

## Differentiation
TDCC is output-first rather than inventory-first. Developers pay for accepted AI work instead of managing raw GPU hours.

## Mission
AI infrastructure should be open, verifiable, and broadly owned.
